name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: ordering & kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, protect your kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the signal drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare and then mark the order as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU WON'T HIT
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long that takes. If a collection time is full, customers can't choose it. That way the queue fits your kitchen.

TAKING ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Add at-the-truck orders on the same screen as the orders placed ahead, so the kitchen works with one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what you need to make now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs to be started.

PRINTING ORDER TICKETS
Connect a receipt printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or via your local network, and order tickets are printed automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, ordering ahead pauses, so nobody places an order you don't see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synchronised as soon as you are back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and pitches once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
